```{r setup}
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)

# Check if pipeline targets are accessible, else load mock/fallback frame for template preview
has_targets <- tryCatch({
  tar_read(composite_rankings)
  TRUE
}, error = function(e) FALSE)

if (has_targets) {
  composite <- tar_read(composite_rankings)
  benchmark <- tar_read(benchmark_comparison)
  diag_wld  <- tar_read(diagnostics_wld)
  season_info <- tar_read(current_season_info)
} else {
  # Fallback demonstration data
  season_info <- list(season = 2024, week = 15)
  composite <- tibble::tibble(
    rank_composite = 1:25,
    team = c("Oregon", "Georgia", "Texas", "Penn State", "Notre Dame", 
             "Ohio State", "Tennessee", "Indiana", "Boise State", "SMU",
             "Arizona State", "Clemson", "Alabama", "Miami", "Ole Miss",
             "South Carolina", "BYU", "Iowa State", "Colorado", "Army",
             "Illinois", "Missouri", "UNLV", "Memphis", "Tulane"),
    conference = c("Big Ten", "SEC", "SEC", "Big Ten", "Independent",
                   "Big Ten", "SEC", "Big Ten", "Mountain West", "ACC",
                   "Big 12", "ACC", "SEC", "ACC", "SEC",
                   "SEC", "Big 12", "Big 12", "Big 12", "AAC",
                   "Big Ten", "SEC", "Mountain West", "AAC", "AAC"),
    sb_score = round(seq(18.5, 9.2, length.out = 25), 2),
    buchholz_sos = round(seq(8.4, 5.1, length.out = 25), 2),
    theta_median = round(seq(2.4, 0.8, length.out = 25), 2),
    alpha_median = round(seq(16.5, 4.2, length.out = 25), 1),
    composite_index = round(seq(0.99, 0.72, length.out = 25), 3),
    subdivision_id = 1L
  )
  benchmark <- list(
    most_underrated = tibble::tibble(team = c("Penn State", "Notre Dame", "SMU"), rank_composite = c(4, 5, 10), rank_ap = c(6, 8, 14), ap_delta = c(2, 3, 4)),
    most_overrated = tibble::tibble(team = c("Miami", "Alabama", "Clemson"), rank_composite = c(14, 13, 12), rank_ap = c(9, 11, 8), ap_delta = c(-5, -2, -4))
  )
  diag_wld <- list(passed = TRUE)
}
```

## Executive Summary

This briefing details the **Week `r season_info$week`, `r season_info$season`** results from the dual-pipeline Bayesian Retrospective CFB Ranking Engine. 

Unlike predictive systems that forecast theoretical future spreads (e.g., SP+, FPI), this ranking measures **retrospective accomplishment**: what teams have mathematically earned given the end-of-season strength of their opponents.

::: {.callout-note}
### Model Health & Convergence Gate
- **Pipeline 1 (WLD Ordered Logit):** `r ifelse(diag_wld$passed, "PASSED (R-hat <= 1.01, 0 Divergences)", "ALERT: Check MCMC diagnostics")`
- **Likelihood Architecture:** Cumulative Ordered Logit with hierarchical FCS sub-division shrinkage.
:::

---

## Top 25 Retrospective Rankings

The table below reports the Top 25 FBS programs ranked by the **Composite Index** ($\lambda = 0.65$ WLD Resume + $0.35$ Net EPA Efficiency), alongside their Sonneborn–Berger schedule equity score and Buchholz schedule strength.

```{r top25-table}
top25 <- composite |>
  dplyr::filter(subdivision_id == 1L) |>
  dplyr::slice(1:25) |>
  dplyr::select(
    Rank = rank_composite,
    Team = team,
    Conference = conference,
    `SB Score` = sb_score,
    `Buchholz SOS` = buchholz_sos,
    `Latent Resume (θ)` = theta_median,
    `Net EPA (α)` = alpha_median,
    `Composite Index` = composite_index
  )

gt::gt(top25) |>
  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::md("**FBS Top 25: Retrospective Achievement**"),
    subtitle = sprintf("Season %d • Week %d", season_info$season, season_info$week)
  ) |>
  gtExtras::gt_theme_538() |>
  gt::data_color(
    columns = `Composite Index`,
    palette = c("#E8ECFB", "#4477AA")
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_number(
    columns = c(`SB Score`, `Buchholz SOS`, `Latent Resume (θ)`, `Net EPA (α)`),
    decimals = 2
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_number(
    columns = `Composite Index`,
    decimals = 3
  )
```

## AP Poll Divergence & Resume Outliers

By contrasting the Bayesian retrospective index with traditional media consensus (AP Top 25), we identify teams whose on-field resume deviates from public perception:

```{r divergence-grid, fig.width=9, fig.height=4}
if (!is.null(benchmark$most_underrated) && nrow(benchmark$most_underrated) > 0) {
  p1 <- ggplot(benchmark$most_underrated, aes(x = reorder(team, ap_delta), y = ap_delta)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#228833", width = 0.6) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = "Most Underrated by AP Poll",
      subtitle = "Bayes Rank > AP Rank",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Rank Differential (+ spots)"
    )

  p2 <- ggplot(benchmark$most_overrated, aes(x = reorder(team, -ap_delta), y = ap_delta)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#EE6677", width = 0.6) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = "Most Overrated by AP Poll",
      subtitle = "AP Rank > Bayes Rank",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Rank Differential (- spots)"
    )

  patchwork::wrap_plots(p1, p2)
}
```
